description: This file defines the NotePreviewWidget class, an Android AppWidgetProvider that manages a widget displaying note previews, handling updates, deletions, and widget options.

classes.name: NotePreviewWidget
classes.description: An Android widget provider class that displays note previews and handles widget lifecycle events.

methods.name: updateAppWidget
methods.description: Updates the widget UI with note data retrieved from SharedPreferences, setting up click intents to open notes.

methods.name: getActivityOptionsBundle
methods.description: Creates and returns an ActivityOptions bundle for activity start animations, depending on Android version.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Removes stored widget data from SharedPreferences when widgets are deleted.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Iterates over widget IDs to update each widget.
